summary: This lease appears broadly fair and tenant-friendly. The core terms around rent, deposit, notice, and fees look balanced and do not show obvious illegal or unusually one-sided clauses.
sentences: This Residential Lease Agreement is made between Jane Smith (Landlord) and Robert Chen (Tenant) for the premises at 421 Oak Street, Los Angeles, California.
The monthly rent is $2,400 payable in advance, due on the 1st day of each month.
The Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $2,400, which is fully refundable and shall be returned within 21 days of move-out, less lawful deductions for damage beyond normal wear and tear.
The lease term is 12 months, commencing on Lease Start: June 1, 2026 and ending on Lease End: May 31, 2027.
Either party may terminate this agreement at the end of the term by providing 30 days written notice to the other party.
The Landlord shall provide at least 24 hours written notice before entering the premises, except in case of emergency, per CA Civil Code Section 1954.
Utilities: the Tenant pays electricity and internet, while the Landlord pays for water and trash collection.
Pets: one cat is permitted with prior written approval, and no additional pet rent applies.
A late fee of $50 applies if rent is received more than 5 days after the due date, following a grace period.
The Landlord is responsible for structural repairs and maintaining the premises in habitable condition, while the Tenant handles minor upkeep.
Any rent increase requires at least 30 days written notice as required by law.
